verdict.rationale: Finix says more than 10 report types (transactions, disputes, fees) are automated in a 'personal dashboard', and that payouts and seller payouts can be managed through the Dashboard or API. These suggest reporting exists, but the evidence never shows sellers themselves getting a self-serve view of their own money data. Missing for 10: an explicit seller-facing self-serve portal, per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports tying payouts to transactions, CSV/bookkeeper-ready exports, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
